title: Connect a hardware wallet to Daedalus

summary.text: Daedalus supports Ledger Nano S, Ledger Nano S Plus, Ledger Nano X, Ledger Flex and Trezor Model T. You pair a device once, and after that you connect it only when you need to confirm a transaction.

problem.text: A Ledger or Trezor device does not connect to Daedalus.

symptoms.text: Daedalus does not show the device as ready.

user_phrases.text: Daedalus does not see my Trezor

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

resolutions.why: Pair opens the hardware wallet pairing dialog.

resolutions.action: Connect the device and enter your PIN on the device to unlock it.
resolutions.why: Daedalus waits for an unlocked device.

resolutions.action: When Daedalus asks, launch the Cardano application on the device.
resolutions.why: Daedalus talks to the device through its Cardano application.

resolutions.action: When Daedalus asks, export the public key on the device.
resolutions.why: Daedalus needs the public key to show the wallet.

resolutions.action: Enter a wallet name and select Pair wallet.
resolutions.why: Pairing adds the device's wallet to Daedalus.

resolutions.action: If pairing fails, disconnect and reconnect the device to restart the process.
resolutions.why: Daedalus gives this instruction when the connection fails.

resolutions.action: If Daedalus says Trezor Bridge is not installed, install it using the Installation instructions link.
resolutions.why: A Trezor connects through Trezor Bridge.

resolutions.action: If Daedalus shows Outdated Ledger software! or Unsupported firmware!, update the device using the link Daedalus shows next to the message.
resolutions.why: Daedalus links to the device maker's update instructions.

expected_outcome.text: The device's wallet appears in Daedalus under the name you gave it, and you connect the device only to confirm transactions.

do_not: Do not enter your device's recovery phrase in Daedalus or on a website, and enter its PIN only on the device.
escalate_when: The receiving address on your hardware wallet differs from the one Daedalus shows.

evidence.rationale: Release notes, tagged source and portal pages directly state the behavior; this is source inspection, not runtime testing.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
